Thanks for your report. I can't reproduce anything malicious about that link. Are you able to reproduce this still? do you have the code that caused the issue saved somewhere so we can track what would be going on in your case? Is there a chance you used any browser extensions or your environment otherwise got tainted unrelated?

I've just compared the 4.75.6 from jsDelivr with unpkg, npm and a local build, as well as the 4.75.7 from those sources and see no unexpected differences.

Do you have any more information?
